description_full: PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk engages in the retail distribution of consumer products in Indonesia. The company offers food and non-food products. It also operates minimarket networks and franchise services under the Alfamart brand. In addition, the company engages in the retail distribution of cosmetics; retail and wholesale distribution of consumer products through internet; and pharmacy business. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Tangerang, Indonesia. PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk operates as a subsidiary of PT. Sigmantara Alfindo.

culture_narrative: Employs approximately 98K people. Revenue per employee of $71K ranks in the bottom quartile among Consumer Defensive peers. Each employee generates $2K of free cash flow annually.
financial_summary: PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya TBK is a small-cap consumer defensive business with a $2.0B market cap on $7.0B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +6% over the past three years, a respectable pace for a business of this size.

Returns on capital run at 20% against a 9% cost of capital — a 10-point spread that is the clearest signature of an economic moat, and 22% gross margins are typical of commodity economics where competitors can replicate the product cheaply.
The business throws off $149M in free cash flow — roughly 2 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage of 24× is fortress-like.

Shareholder yield of 4.8% reflects a genuine commitment to returning capital rather than empire-building, and insiders hold 72% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and profit capture is only 0.3× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
